acceptedInterpretation: Fix BOTH sides of the metadataRoot defect: the production snapshot signing (captureReviewRunSnapshot/diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot threaded with workspace.metadataRoot||ctx.root) AND the consumer freshness recompute (run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot). The consumer-only or storyFilesHash-only interpretations are rejected because materialHash has no fallback, so the signed snapshot would stay wrong and the false-stale would persist. Confirmed by repro-first red evidence (rp-mr1fmmur-clkpwd, red-reviewed target-bug) and a confirmed spike (sr-mr1fp8ob-6k3tki).
